name: forge/github-write-file
description: Create or update a file in a GitHub repository branch with a single commit. Content is passed raw (the builtin handles encoding). Requires the GITHUB_TOKEN secret and AI Forge's github_write_file builtin (ships with the backend).

tool.name: github_write_file
tool.description: Write a file to a branch in a GitHub repository, committing it with the given message. Creates the file if it does not exist, updates it otherwise. The target branch must already exist.

owner.description: GitHub owner or organization of the repository

path.description: File path relative to the repository root

content.description: Full file content (plain text, not encoded)

branch.description: Branch to commit to (must already exist; there is no default on purpose)
